kinds.search-incomplete: a reviewed literature search whose protocol obligations are not all met: the atlas may not say that no demonstration was found
kinds.source-read-pending: a search hit that could not be decided for want of its text
kinds.evidence-single-source: a claim one paper reports, with no independent confirmation recorded
kinds.evidence-interpretation-pending: a claim several groups cite that stays reported because an interpretation the primary text must settle is pending
kinds.evidence-not-observed: a claim predicted by theory or proposed, not yet observed
kinds.pathway-observed-not-delivered: a composition traversed in one experiment whose output was not delivered to a load
kinds.measurement-boundary-unresolved: a recorded figure whose numerator's boundary the source does not state
kinds.measurement-definition-unresolved: a recorded figure whose defining quantities have not been read from the source

residuals.statement: Lu et al. 2024's actual thermal efficiency of 2.46 % is recorded as the platform's reported system figure without knowing whether its numerator is the grid-connected electrical power (47.4 kW) or the net cycle work of the paper's Equation 9.
residuals.why_unresolved: The conclusion reports both figures side by side without saying which power the efficiency uses; the design point (2.63 %) demonstrably uses net cycle work, so the actual figure may be a route figure or an organic-Rankine-stage figure.
residuals.what_exists: Recorded as "2.46%" (laboratory, 2024); sources source:lu-2024-otec-platform; basis: as reported: the authors' actual thermal efficiency in the stable-operation phase (Figure 12). The paper defines thermal efficiency as net cycle work over evaporator heat (Equation 9) and reports 2.46 % beside the 47.4 kW maximum grid-connected power without saying which numerator the actual figure uses — a route figure if the grid-connected power, an organic-Rankine-stage figure if the net cycle work; the boundary is unresolved (pass 45).
residuals.closure_condition: Establish from the primary source (or its authors) whether the 2.46 % uses grid-connected electrical output or Equation-9 net cycle work, then restage or keep the datum with that basis.

residuals.statement: The NiTi shape-memory heat engine's 1.5 % thermal-to-electrical efficiency (10.5 % of Carnot at the reported point) is an unstructured datum: the paper's definition of the heat input and its temperatures have not been read, so the figure carries no metric, no numeric value and no boundary.
residuals.why_unresolved: Pass 7 recorded the figure from the paper's summary; passes 39 and 45 typed every other efficiency datum but could not classify this one without the heat-input definition.
residuals.what_exists: Recorded as "1.5% (10.5% of Carnot at the reported maximum-efficiency operating point)" (laboratory, 2019); sources source:sma-heat-engine-2019; no basis.
residuals.closure_condition: Read the primary's heat-input definition and operating temperatures; then record the datum as conversion-efficiency (or device-stage-efficiency) with its basis, and type its Carnot-relative clause.
